categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in pharmaceutical distribution and retail, focusing on the off-hospital market. Its main segments include pharmaceutical B2B e-commerce, pharmaceutical wholesale (terminal direct sales and commercial distribution), pharmaceutical retail (both online and offline), new industrial models (including MAH and OEM), intelligent logistics, and medical new media. It also invests in healthcare services, internet medical services, and health media platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages internet, big data, AI, and intelligent algorithms to build a digitalized pharmaceutical supply chain and retail ecosystem. It has developed integrated platforms including business, data, and technology middle platforms to support supply chain synchronization, intelligent warehousing, and digital marketing. The new industrial model involves MAH (Marketing Authorization Holder) and OEM production, collaborating with CROs and CDMOs for drug development and registration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include community pharmacies, grassroots medical institutions, retail drugstores, clinics, and pharmaceutical chains across China. The company serves over 78,800 certified customers nationwide, including approximately 2,100 pharmaceutical chains, 38,700 retail pharmacies, 16,600 clinics, and 17,900 grassroots medical institutions. It also targets end consumers through online retail platforms and O2O models.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with a strong presence in Southwest China (accounting for about 78.7% of revenue), and expanding coverage in Northwest, North China, Central China, South China, East China, and Northeast China. It also has subsidiaries and investments in Hong Kong and Hainan, and is expanding into Henan and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on pharmaceutical wholesale distribution, retail, and e-commerce platforms. It also extends upstream through MAH drug production and OEM partnerships, integrating supply chain services from manufacturers to end consumers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening supply chain advantages, enhancing full-channel and full-scenario service capabilities, and deepening the SBBC ecosystem. The company invests heavily in digital transformation, AI, big data, and intelligent logistics. R&D focuses on MAH drug development, digital platforms for supply chain and retail, and new industrial models. It also emphasizes C-end retail expansion, internet medical services, and health media integration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales in pharmaceutical wholesale and retail, including B2B e-commerce and B2C online sales. The company also earns membership fees, advertising services for suppliers, and value-added services such as digital supply chain solutions. Profit mainly comes from the margin between purchase and sales prices, including rebates from suppliers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a regional leader in pharmaceutical distribution in Southwest China and ranks 40th nationally among pharmaceutical wholesale enterprises. It is recognized as a national-level e-commerce demonstration enterprise and holds a strong brand reputation. The company faces competition from traditional pharmaceutical distributors, emerging pharmaceutical e-commerce platforms, and cross-industry entrants, emphasizing its competitive edge in supply chain integration and digital capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 4.43 billion, an 11.62% increase from 2022, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 59.53 million, up 41.69%. The company has steadily grown its customer base and expanded its e-commerce platform, with over 78,800 certified customers and 1.55 million average weekly active users. It maintains a stable asset base of RMB 1.69 billion and continues to invest in technology and new business models.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes a comprehensive, full-channel pharmaceutical supply chain ecosystem (SBBC) that integrates suppliers, business partners, small business partners, and customers. It differentiates through digital innovation, intelligent logistics, extensive product variety (over 23,000 SKUs), and broad terminal coverage. Its unique value lies in efficient, low-cost pharmaceutical distribution services tailored to off-hospital markets, supported by advanced AI and big data platforms that enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.
